name: Come Together
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from The Villager (Farmingdale) - live music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Facebook and Instagram come from the QR-code image on the band's own home page (the Facebook QR decodes to facebook.com/qr?id=61565240183124); the site has no text links to them. Booking is via the site's contact form (no public email or phone). The site also has a group promo photo by the water (band-water-jo.png) but it is only 588 px wide, so it was not used. Not the Melbourne Beatles tribute 'Come Together - The Music of The Beatles'.
description: A five-piece Long Island cover band that plays sing-along hits from the 1960s and 1970s, such as songs by The Beatles, The Rolling Stones and The Kinks, and takes song requests from the crowd.

logo.alt: Come Together! logo: five cartoon dancers in colorful clothes above the band name in big red letters

photos.alt: Five side-by-side photos of Come Together's members playing guitar, bass, vocals and drums in front of a brick wall at a bar

evidence.note: Band site says it is a Long Island band playing hits of the 60s, 70s and beyond (Beatles, Rolling Stones, Kinks, King Harvest) and lists Fri 10/16/26 6:00 at The Villager, Farmingdale, matching our listing.
The Villager Farmingdale lists 'Live Music: Come Together' on Friday Oct 16, 2026, 6-9 PM.
Event listing describes Come Together as a Long Island band playing the music of the 60s and 70s (Toomey's Tavern, Amityville).
Image on the band's site: 'You can find us on Instagram & Facebook' with handle COME_TOGETHER_BAND_LI; the Facebook QR code decodes to page id 61565240183124.
